================================================================================
Long keyword whose prefix is a higher-precedence keyword
================================================================================
:alpha
---
(program (long_keyword))

================================================================================
Long keyword after whitespace
================================================================================
: alpha
---
(program (long_keyword))

================================================================================
Short higher-precedence keyword
================================================================================
!a
---
(program (short_keyword))

================================================================================
Higher-precedence short keyword wins over a longer token sharing its prefix
:error
================================================================================
!a-
---
(program (short_keyword) (ERROR (UNEXPECTED '-')))

================================================================================
Keyword spellings are identifiers in identifier position
================================================================================
alpha
---
(program (identifier))

================================================================================
Short keyword spelling is an identifier in identifier position
================================================================================
a
---
(program (identifier))

================================================================================
Long keyword does not match a prefix of a longer word
:error
================================================================================
:alphabet
---
(program (ERROR) (identifier))
